description: External alterations to install replacement cladding on both clock tower elevations.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the re-cladding of the external surfaces of the clocktower elevations shall be as detailed in the drawings/supporting material hereby approved.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Procedure Document (A46523) [received 13/10/2020], Drawings 19142 MCM XX ZZ DR A 01120 (P03), 19142 MCM XX ZZ DR A 01121 (P03), 19142 MCM XX ZZ DR A 01132 (P02), 19142 MCM XX ZZ DR A 01131 (P02) and 19142 MCM XX ZZ DR A 01133 (P02) [received 29/09/2020], and 19142 MCM XX ZZ DR A 01102 (P01) and Planning, Heritage and Advertisement Statement (August 2020) [received 12/08/2020]) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - All vehicles associated with the installation shall only park/ stop at permitted locations and within the time periods permitted by existing on-street restrictions. No skips or construction materials shall be kept on the footway or carriageway on the TLRN at any time.
Condition : 5 - The installation of the replacement cladding shall be undertaken in compliance with the method/risk statement hereby approved ('Procedure Document - ref. A46523').
